title: Bar Drop Strawberry Coconut 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: Bar Drop Salts Strawberry Coconut by Drop is a creamy fruit fusion with a tropical twist. It combines the familiar, sweet taste of ripe strawberries with the smooth, exotic flavour of coconut. The result is a rich and velvety vape that feels indulgent and summery. This e-liquid utilises a 40% VG / 60% PG ratio to enhance the fruit notes, ensuring the strawberry remains bright against the creamy coconut backdrop. Ideally suited for low-wattage MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) devices, the nicotine salt base ensures a smooth and comfortable draw, available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg strengths. Manufactured by UK brand Drop, Bar Drop Salts range of nic salt e-liquids focus on fruity flavours that are endlessly popular as well as a few unique profiles you won’t find anywhere else.
